description: Wordle — guess the 5-letter word in 6 tries with green/yellow/gray feedback and a full on-screen keyboard.

faqs.a: Green = right letter, right spot. Yellow = the letter is in the word but in a different spot. Gray = the letter isn't in the word at all (watch out for duplicate letters).
Every guess must be a real word — it's checked against a 15,900-word valid-guess list. The answers come from a curated list of 1,300+ common words.
Played, won, current streak and max streak are saved in your browser and shown under the board.

howto: Type a 5-letter word (or tap the on-screen keyboard) and press Enter.
Read the tile colors: green = correct, yellow = misplaced, gray = absent.
You have 6 guesses to find the word.
Press “New word” for a fresh puzzle.
title: Wordle
